thread:
Noah (Docs): quick heads-up: i'm updating the quotas & pricing migration doc. need confirmation on header rename and a tiny SDK migration example.
Aria (Eng): which header?
Noah (Docs): old docs show X-Quota-Plan in curl examples. backend now accepts x-redwood-quota and we want to mark X-Quota-Plan as deprecated.
Jules (Billing): correct — X-Quota-Plan is deprecated. x-redwood-quota is preferred and can carry 'plan_id:tier' format. we'll keep compatibility for 2 releases but pls add migration note.
Priya (SDK): i can add py/js snippets. prefer to show both curl and SDK minimal changes.
Noah (Docs): great. can we also add an example showing how pricing tier mapping affects cost_estimate in /usage/summary? small note about burst credits reconciliation in dashboards too.
Jules (Billing): include this: hosted pricing uses static tier tables; Dedicated may override tiers. cost_estimate is computed with most-recent tier mapping unless tenant_overrides present. burst credits are applied at billing time and won't appear per-minute in the heatmap — add a callout.
Aria (Eng): rate-limit note: we enforce 120 reqs/min per account for the quotas endpoints; per-route limits still apply. Dedicated clusters can increase this via config. Also switched cursor pagination to cursor_v2, update examples.
Noah (Docs): thanks. drafting now. dropping quick examples here for copyedit: curl, python sdk patch, js sdk patch.
Priya (SDK): looks good, minor nit on error handling.
Noah (Docs): CURL example:
```bash
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/quotas" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "x-redwood-quota: plan:pro" \
  -G --data-urlencode "start=1718592000" --data-urlencode "end=1718678400"
```
Noah (Docs): Python SDK migration snippet:
```python
# old: client.list_quotas(header={'X-Quota-Plan': 'pro'})
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=RW_KEY)
resp = client.get('/quotas', headers={'x-redwood-quota': 'plan:pro'}, params={'start': 1718592000, 'end': 1718678400})
print(resp['items'][0]['limit'])
```
Noah (Docs): JS SDK snippet:
```js
// old: client.request('/quotas', { headers: {'X-Quota-Plan': 'pro'} })
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const res = await client.get('/quotas', { headers: { 'x-redwood-quota': 'plan:pro' }, params: { start: 1718592000, end: 1718678400 } })
console.log(res.data.items[0].limit)
```
Priya (SDK): suggest adding a tiny try/catch in both snippets to show 400 handling for bad plan values. i'll paste that in PR comments.
Noah (Docs): noted. also adding migration callout: "Deprecation: X-Quota-Plan -> use x-redwood-quota. Compatibility shims available until v2.0."
Jules (Billing): also add a privacy line: do not include raw billing rates in public docs; use cost_estimate and anonymized bands for examples.
Noah (Docs): will do. Link issue: i found old references to /pricing/legacy-tiers in the quota doc. LinkBot?
LinkBot: found 2 matches for /pricing/legacy-tiers in branch docs/quota-header-migration -> opened PR #4380 to replace with /pricing/tiers.
Noah (Docs): sweet. i'll link PR #4380 in the changelog.
Aria (Eng): small ops note: the cursor_v2 token is opaque now; mention that clients should pass it verbatim.
Noah (Docs): good catch. will add snippet showing cursor usage.
Noah (Docs): cursor example:
```bash
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/quotas?cursor=CURSOR_TOKEN" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY"
```
Noah (Docs): final ask: can someone do a quick review of wording around "tier override"? i want to avoid implying customers can arbitrarily change hosted tiers.
Jules (Billing): i'll reword. propose: "Hosted customers receive tiers per billing agreement; platform teams may request tenant overrides via support."
Noah (Docs): perfect. planning to land PR by EOD. thanks for the quick turn. :raised_hands:
